name: Voltra
summary: A nine-page personal finance app in black and glowing neon, with a clean light theme
about: A complete personal finance starter for banking apps, budgeting apps and money trackers, drawn in black with neon green and pink glows, plus a light theme. Nine working pages cover the dashboard, accounts, transactions, budgets, cards, goals, bills, insights and settings. Charts glow and morph, budget rings sweep in, and neon cards tilt in 3D as you move over them.
how: Open any of the nine pages from the sidebar
Switch the cash-flow chart between 7D, 30D and 12M and watch it morph
Add, edit or delete transactions; balances, budgets and charts follow
Click a budget ring to change its limit, and add money to goals
Hover a card to tilt it, freeze it, show its number or create a virtual card
Pay bills or toggle autopay, read insights, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data in Settings
